fields.claim_quote: :$\forall x_1, x_2 \in S: (x_1, a \circ x_1) \in \lambda_a \wedge  (x_2, a \circ x_2) \in \lambda_a \implies x_1 = x_2$
fields.explanation: The printed implication uses two graph memberships without equality of second coordinates; the source parastrophe/magma hypothesis is retained. Keep ZMod2 addition,a=0,x1=0,x2=1. Both graph memberships hold but inputs differ; subtraction supplies the parastrophe. Actual ZMod2 group and quantified parastrophe equivalence; literal graph-membership implication is refuted.
fields.flaw: Proof 2's injectivity step asserts, for arbitrary a in S, that for all x_1, x_2 in S, (x_1, a circ x_1) in lambda_a AND (x_2, a circ x_2) in lambda_a implies x_1 = x_2. Since (x, a circ x) belongs to lambda_a for EVERY x by the definition of lambda_a, the antecedent is universally satisfied, so the stated claim literally asserts that S has at most one element. The preceding chain x_1 = a * lambda_a(x_1) = a * lambda_a(x_2) = x_2 uses an unjustified middle equality (many-to-one-ness of lambda_a only gives single-valuedness at a fixed argument, not lambda_a(x_1) = lambda_a(x_2)).
fields.problem:
Title: Left Quasigroup if (2-3) Parastrophe of Magma is Magma

Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a [[Definition:Magma|magma]], where
:$S$ is a [[Definition:Set|set]]
:$\circ : S \times S \to S$ is a [[Definition:Binary Operation|binary operation]] on $S$

Let the [[Definition:(2-3) Parastrophe|$\paren {2 - 3}$ parastrophe]] of $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a [[Definition:Magma|magma]].

Then $\struct {S, \circ}$ is a [[Definition:Left Quasigroup|left quasigroup]].

fields.witness: Take S = Z/2Z with addition, a = 0, x_1 = 0 and x_2 = 1. The graph lambda_0 is {(0,0),(1,1)}, so both displayed graph-membership premises hold, while x_1 != x_2. The source parastrophe hypothesis also holds: define a * b = -a + b; then a + x = b if and only if a * b = x. Thus this structure refutes the printed implication. The selected Lean declarations establish these local facts; no auxiliary enumeration count is part of this witness.
